construction.method: Each posterior-weighted domain score is split at its shared-cohort median.
construction.cut_point_note: Cohort-derived medians are descriptive, not clinical thresholds, and do not transfer unchanged to another sample.

axes.label: Physiologic severity
axes.description: Sleep-study physiology including oxygen desaturation and saturation burden.

axes.label: Symptom burden
axes.description: Sleepiness, insomnia, functional impairment, mood screening, and related symptoms.

axes.label: Comorbidity burden
axes.description: A broad coded-disease gradient that also reflects healthcare contact and record completeness.

octants.label: Mild All
octants.summary: Below the cohort median on physiologic severity, symptoms, and comorbidity burden.

octants.label: Hypoxemia Predominant
octants.summary: Higher nocturnal hypoxemia with comparatively low symptom and comorbidity burden.

octants.label: Symptom Predominant
octants.summary: Higher sleepiness and insomnia burden despite comparatively mild physiologic disturbance.

octants.label: Comorbidity Predominant
octants.summary: Higher coded disease burden with comparatively low physiologic and symptom scores.

octants.label: Hypoxemic Symptomatic
octants.summary: Higher physiologic severity and symptom burden without high comorbidity burden.

octants.label: Hypoxemic Comorbid
octants.summary: Higher physiologic severity and comorbidity burden with comparatively low symptom burden.

octants.label: Symptomatic Comorbid
octants.summary: Higher symptom and comorbidity burden with comparatively mild physiologic disturbance.

octants.label: High All
octants.summary: Above the cohort median on all three phenotype axes.

cluster_profiles.standardized_difference_definition: (group estimate - cohort estimate) / cohort SD; for a binary metric the cohort SD is sqrt(p(1-p)). This is a difference from the cohort the group belongs to, NOT a two-independent-group SMD.
cluster_profiles.estimate_note: Continuous matrix values are means; binary values are proportions. Detailed cards also show medians, quartiles, denominators, and coverage.

survival.comparison: Named octant versus the pooled other seven
survival.estimator: Tie-aware Aalen-Johansen cumulative incidence with death competing
survival.hazard_model: Adjusted M4 ridge cause-specific Cox model
survival.curve_note: Curves are unadjusted; adjusted M4 hazard ratios come from a separate model. Curve separation is descriptive, not adjusted or causal.

testing.gate: All eight octants are shown for each outcome whose 7-df M4 omnibus test reached nominal p < 0.05.
testing.bonferroni: Within each focal-octant contrast, PheCode tests are corrected across 15 gated outcomes (p < 0.05/15) and system tests across 6 (p < 0.05/6), not across 168 panels.
testing.fdr: BH q-values were reconstructed within the original contrast-and-model families and retained only after q <= 0.05 reproduced every stored FDR flag.

model.label: M4
model.cpap_note: CPAP is deliberately not adjusted (it is a mediator on the OSA -> treatment -> outcome path).
model.ph_note: Proportional-hazards diagnostics were not computed for the octant models; ph_p is unavailable for every panel. A blank value is not evidence that the assumption was met.

survival.tail_warning: Mean follow-up is 1.42 years, and only 8.7% of the pooled baseline risk set remains under observation at 3 years. Read the at-risk table before quoting a 3-year cumulative incidence.

disclosure.rule: Exact counts below 11 are null and displayed as Suppressed (<11), never as zero.
disclosure.curve_rule: Curve coordinates are withheld for the 16 panels whose focal event count is suppressed. Their model metadata remain searchable.
disclosure.manifest_correction: The source manifest states that every curve group exceeds 1,000 people; the audited minimum baseline group is 599. The site applies the stricter panel-level withholding rule.

levels.label: PheCode outcomes
levels.description: Incident rule-of-2 PheCodes among people free of the PheCode and its control-exclusion family at index.

levels.label: Body-system outcomes
levels.description: First new PheCode in the system with the whole cohort at risk; diagnostic accrual, not first-ever disease onset.

caveats.title: Continuous gradients
caveats.text: The physiology, symptom, and comorbidity octants are regions of continuous gradients, not discovered biological subpopulations.

caveats.title: Coverage varies
caveats.text: Measures use their available aggregate denominators. Follow-up and encounter metrics cover the 25,380-person IncWAS spine; age, BMI, and sex cover 53,012 people; several symptom scales are incomplete.

caveats.title: Adjusted associations
caveats.text: Octants are strongly structured by age and sex. M4 models adjust for both, but unadjusted cluster and curve comparisons are neither causal nor clinical treatment effects.

caveats.title: CPAP summaries unavailable
caveats.text: CPAP initiation and adherence distributions are not shown because missing capture cannot be distinguished from never-started and mean-usage units are unconfirmed; no defensible denominator is available.

caveats.title: Race/ethnicity withheld
caveats.text: Race/ethnicity is included in M4 adjustment, but no octant breakdown is published because one cell falls below the disclosure threshold and the breakdown is not approved for release.

caveats.title: Sparse-data and PH checks
caveats.text: Eighty of 168 panels are flagged EPV < 10. Proportional-hazards diagnostics were not computed, so unflagged panels should not be labeled stable.
